author: TeIq
content:
## Background

The bunnynabbit `atp-label-indexer` pattern (https://github.com/BunnyNabbit/atp-label-indexer) is: firehose-subscribe to each labeler's `com.atproto.label.subscribeLabels`, verify signatures, persist every label to a local store keyed by `(src, uri, val, neg)`. Query API just reads the local store — no AppView dependency, no hardcoded labeler list at query time, no per-subject network fan-out.

Polaris already has:
- The subscriber: `polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs` (per `upstream_labelers WHERE enabled = TRUE`, signature verify + reconnect-with-backoff).
- The local store: `polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000034_indexed_labels.sql` — UNIQUE `(src, uri, val, neg)`, indexed on `uri`, `src`, `cts DESC`.
- The startup wiring: `polaris-backend/src/main.rs:204` spawns one consumer per upstream.

What is missing: the subscriber persists to `observations` only when Polaris already has a subject row for the label's `uri` (`find_or_create_account_subject` at `upstream_labels.rs:487`). Account-level labels survive that path because the helper creates a subject; **post-level labels for subjects Polaris has never observed are silently dropped**. The local `indexed_labels` table receives nothing.

## Task

In `polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs`, modify `UpstreamLabelerConsumer::handle_frame` to INSERT into `indexed_labels` immediately after signature verification (lines 476-480) and BEFORE the `find_or_create_account_subject` call. The `observations` write stays — both records are useful (the case-view reads `indexed_labels`; the pattern engine reads `observations`).

## Rust quality

- Use `sqlx::query!` (parameterized). Pattern is already established in this file (`flush_cursor`).
- `ON CONFLICT (src, uri, val, neg) DO UPDATE SET cts = EXCLUDED.cts, cid = EXCLUDED.cid, seq = EXCLUDED.seq` so re-emission of a `val` updates the latest assertion, matching the schema's intent.
- Map `cts` from the label's RFC3339 string into `chrono::DateTime<Utc>` via `proto_blue` helpers or `DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339`. The label frame is `proto_blue::api::generated::com::atproto::label::defs::Label`.
- Errors propagate via the existing `HandleError` enum (`thiserror`-derived). Add a `IndexedLabelPersist(sqlx::Error)` variant.
- No `unwrap()`/`expect()` outside `#[cfg(test)]`.
- Test coverage:
  - Unit test: insert two labels with same `(src, uri, val, neg)` → second wins; verify single row, latest `cts`.
  - Unit test: insert one with `neg=true` then `neg=false` for the same `(src, uri, val)` → two rows (assert + retract history preserved).
  - Integration test pattern from `polaris-backend/tests/threats_common/mod.rs` (testcontainers Postgres) for the SQL path.

## References

- Schema: `polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000034_indexed_labels.sql`
- Label wire shape: `proto_blue::api::generated::com::atproto::label::defs::Label`
- Existing parameterized-query pattern: `polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs:564-579` (`flush_cursor`)
- Bunnynabbit indexer reference: `index.cjs` — persists every verified label to MongoDB

## Acceptance

1. Receiving a verified label for an arbitrary URI (no pre-existing Polaris subject) results in a row in `indexed_labels` with all wire fields populated.
2. Same `(src, uri, val, neg)` arriving twice → one row, latest `cts`/`seq`.
3. `cargo test -p polaris-backend ingest::upstream_labels::tests::persists_to_indexed_labels` passes.
4. `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` clean.
